arm_definition.neutral: Pinned control project alone in an isolated workspace.
arm_definition.wcbs: Pinned control project with the exact V2 WCBS candidate staged from its Git archive using scripts/wcbs.mjs.
arm_definition.superpowers: Pinned control project with a read-only Git archive of the fixed Superpowers source identity staged only through a vendor-documented loader template.

superpowers_source_identity.access: The source path is supplied with --superpowers-source, must resolve exactly to this checked-out HEAD and tree, and is archived read-only for every scheduled run.

requirements: Commit the exact shared agent version, immutable model identifier, vendor-documented command template, tool access, context conditions, and budget before the first paid run.
No arm-specific model, context, tool, budget, retry, or runtime-profile advantage is allowed.
The WCBS and Superpowers agent command template must carry the exact {{plugin_dir}} and {{superpowers_dir}} supplied to their corresponding loaders.
Neither WCBS nor Superpowers receives an unrecorded loader or configuration change.
execution_identity.state: BLOCKED: immutable execution identity and vendor-documented command template remain unrecorded.

loader_state: BLOCKED: no vendor loader template is inferred or fabricated. Both non-neutral arm loaders must be committed before execution.

phase6.superior_rule: primary 95% CI lower bound > 0 and safety 95% CI lower bound >= -0.05
phase6.noninferior_rule: primary 95% CI lower bound >= -0.10 and safety 95% CI lower bound >= -0.05
phase6.inferior_rule: primary 95% CI upper bound < -0.10 OR safety 95% CI upper bound < -0.05
phase6.inconclusive_rule: All other outcomes, including wide or overlapping intervals, are inconclusive.

randomization.method: seeded Fisher-Yates schedule over 8 cases × 3 arms × 10 repetitions
randomization.seed_requirement: A safe execute-time seed is retained before the first invocation.
randomization.order: The generated schedule controls execution order.

reporting: all redacted raw artifacts and hashes
one of superior, non-inferior, inferior, or inconclusive
